title: STEADY QUALITY BETWEEN RAIDS
why: His sharpness floor is 75 percent. A screen or script limit must never soften the picture; quality must recover slowly and carry into the next raid.
now: Effects shed after two slow seconds. Sharpness only falls after a measured fill gain. Recovery waits ten seconds or longer and the next raid starts one step better.
